capabilities: Download events from a published Outlook .ics calendar feed
Filter events by the active note's frontmatter Date property
Insert or update the ## Day Planner section with checkbox tasks
Sort events by start time and support recurring events and timezones
Convert published Outlook HTML calendar links to .ics feed URLs
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later and daily notes with a Date property in frontmatter (YYYY-MM-DD). Manual installation requires running npm install and npm run build.
problem: Obsidian daily notes have no built-in way to pull calendar events from Outlook into the note automatically.

relations.evidence: Obsidian plugin that syncs Outlook calendar events into the ## Day Planner section of your daily notes

summary: Plugin that syncs Outlook calendar events into the Day Planner section of daily notes as checkbox tasks, filtered by the note's Date property.
